name: Boon: Illumination

description.content: Bless a Dull or Hex Totem to create a Boon Totem with a [24m] range.
Survivors within range see the Auras of all Chests and Generators.
While you have a Boon Totem, you bless [200%] faster.

quote: "A shift in reality. Heavy with hidden meanings." -Return
